title: 洪水預報與水庫聯合操作
titleEn: Flood forecasting and coordinated reservoir operation
subcategoryTitle: 輸配水、河川與都市防洪
subcategoryTitleEn: Water conveyance, rivers and urban flood protection
summary: 將預報誤差、河道傳播時間、庫容與下游通洪能力放在同一個運算框架，練習集合機率、校準、預洩與衝突限制辨識。教材以兩座假想水庫展示聯合操作所需的狀態和責任邊界，計算結果只作方法教學，實際操作仍需正式規程與有權機關決策。
summaryEn: Place forecast uncertainty, routing time, storage and downstream capacity in one calculation framework. Exercises cover ensemble probabilities, calibration, prerelease and conflicting constraints. Two hypothetical reservoirs illustrate the states and responsibilities required for coordinated operation. Results teach methods rather than authorize releases; real decisions require approved operating rules, current observations and the responsible institutions.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「集合超越機率」與「分位數與有限成員」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ensemble exceedance probability" and "Quantiles with finite ensembles": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 集合超越機率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ensemble exceedance probability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「集合超越機率」如何影響洪水預報與水庫聯合操作的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ensemble exceedance probability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Flood forecasting and coordinated reservoir operation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 集合預報用多個可能情境表達不確定性，超過指定流量門檻的成員比例可作經驗超越機率。這些成員不一定相互獨立，也可能共享降雨偏差，因此比例不是自然界真實機率的保證。門檻必須對應同一地點、時段與流量定義，瞬時峰值不能與日平均混用。操作比較應同時看後果與機率，並透過過往未參與校準的事件檢查可靠度，而不是只選最樂觀的成員作決策依據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「集合超越機率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An ensemble expresses uncertainty through alternative scenarios, and the fraction exceeding a threshold gives an empirical exceedance probability. Members may be dependent or share rainfall bias, so the fraction is not a guarantee of nature's true probability. Match location, lead period and discharge definition; instantaneous peaks differ from daily means. Compare consequences as well as probabilities, and evaluate reliability on events excluded from calibration instead of basing decisions on the most optimistic member. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ensemble exceedance probability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Ne=8 members above-threshold; N=20 equally-weighted-members; p=Ne/N=0.4 dimensionless。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Ne=8 members above-threshold; N=20 equally-weighted-members; p=Ne/N=0.4 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「集合中四成成員超越就保證真實洪水機率恰為四成」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Forty percent ensemble exceedance guarantees the true flood probability is exactly forty percent" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「集合超越機率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Ensemble exceedance probability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 集合超越機率
knowledge.text: 集合預報用多個可能情境表達不確定性，超過指定流量門檻的成員比例可作經驗超越機率。這些成員不一定相互獨立，也可能共享降雨偏差，因此比例不是自然界真實機率的保證。
knowledge.textEn: An ensemble expresses uncertainty through alternative scenarios, and the fraction exceeding a threshold gives an empirical exceedance probability. Members may be dependent or share rainfall bias, so the fraction is not a guarantee of nature's true probability.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：集合中四成成員超越就保證真實洪水機率恰為四成 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Forty percent ensemble exceedance guarantees the true flood probability is exactly forty percent Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「集合超越機率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ensemble exceedance probability" is correct?
options: 集合中四成成員超越就保證真實洪水機率恰為四成
集合預報用多個可能情境表達不確定性，超過指定流量門檻的成員比例可作經驗超越機率。
九成分位數就是所有可能洪水永遠不會超越的上限
optionsEn: Forty percent ensemble exceedance guarantees the true flood probability is exactly forty percent
An ensemble expresses uncertainty through alternative scenarios, and the fraction exceeding a threshold gives an empirical exceedance probability.
The ninetieth percentile is an upper bound that every possible flood must obey
quiz.explanation: 集合預報用多個可能情境表達不確定性，超過指定流量門檻的成員比例可作經驗超越機率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An ensemble expresses uncertainty through alternative scenarios, and the fraction exceeding a threshold gives an empirical exceedance probability. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 集合超越機率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ensemble exceedance probability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「集合超越機率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ensemble exceedance probability” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Ne=8 members above-threshold; N=20 equally-weighted-members; p=Ne/N=0.4 dimensionless。適用邊界：等權情境的經驗比例，非已驗證校準之真實洪水機率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Ne=8 members above-threshold; N=20 equally-weighted-members; p=Ne/N=0.4 dimensionless. Applicable boundary: Empirical fraction of equally weighted scenarios, not a demonstrated calibrated probability of flooding. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：固定預報發布時刻、有效時段與斷面門檻，逐一檢查成員是否超越。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Fix issue time, valid period and section threshold before counting exceedances.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Ne=8 members above-threshold; N=20 equally-weighted-members; p=Ne/N=0.4 dimensionless。適用邊界：等權情境的經驗比例，非已驗證校準之真實洪水機率。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Ne=8 members above-threshold; N=20 equally-weighted-members; p=Ne/N=0.4 dimensionless. Applicable boundary: Empirical fraction of equally weighted scenarios, not a demonstrated calibrated probability of flooding.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「集合超越機率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ensemble exceedance probability", which statement holds?
options: 水庫水位增加一公尺就代表固定不變的一立方公尺庫容增加
下游剩餘流量額度可不經路由直接當成上游即時閘門指令
原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Ne=8 members above-threshold; N=20 equally-weighted-members; p=Ne/N=0.4 dimensionless。
optionsEn: A one-metre reservoir level rise always means a fixed one-cubic-metre storage increase
Residual downstream flow allowance can directly become an immediate upstream gate command without routing
Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Ne=8 members above-threshold.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Ne=8 members above-threshold; N=20 equally-weighted-members; p=Ne/N=0.4 dimensionless。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Ne=8 members above-threshold; N=20 equally-weighted-members; p=Ne/N=0.4 dimensionless. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 集合超越機率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ensemble exceedance probability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「集合超越機率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ensemble exceedance probability” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 固定預報發布時刻、有效時段與斷面門檻，逐一檢查成員是否超越。用獨立歷史預報回放分組比較預報機率和實際發生頻率，保留漏報與誤報紀錄，並確認沒有事後雨量被偷偷加入當時預報。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fix issue time, valid period and section threshold before counting exceedances. Use independent forecast replays to compare probability groups with observed frequencies, retaining misses and false alarms and ensuring later rainfall observations were not inserted into earlier forecasts. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持二十個等權成員，將超越數增加到十個重算比例。說明需要哪些歷史樣本才能檢查這個機率是否可靠，並列出成員相關可能造成的限制。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep twenty equally weighted members and increase exceedances to ten. Recalculate the fraction, identify historical samples needed to test reliability, and describe limitations caused by dependence between ensemble members across the forecast set.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：集合全部偏低時，即使成員看似一致也可能漏掉洪水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A consistently low ensemble can miss flooding despite strong member agreement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 固定預報發布時刻、有效時段與斷面門檻，逐一檢查成員是否超越。用獨立歷史預報回放分組比較預報機率和實際發生頻率，保留漏報與誤報紀錄，並確認沒有事後雨量被偷偷加入當時預報。
knowledge.textEn: Fix issue time, valid period and section threshold before counting exceedances. Use independent forecast replays to compare probability groups with observed frequencies, retaining misses and false alarms and ensuring later rainfall observations were not inserted into earlier forecasts.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 保持二十個等權成員，將超越數增加到十個重算比例。說明需要哪些歷史樣本才能檢查這個機率是否可靠，並列出成員相關可能造成的限制。
knowledge.textEn: Keep twenty equally weighted members and increase exceedances to ten. Recalculate the fraction, identify historical samples needed to test reliability, and describe limitations caused by dependence between ensemble members across the forecast set.

quiz.question: 要驗證「集合超越機率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ensemble exceedance probability"?
options: 固定預報發布時刻、有效時段與斷面門檻，逐一檢查成員是否超越。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
求解器有回傳數字就代表原本所有操作限制都已滿足
optionsEn: Fix issue time, valid period and section threshold before counting exceedances.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Any number returned by a solver proves that all original operating constraints are satisfied
quiz.explanation: 固定預報發布時刻、有效時段與斷面門檻，逐一檢查成員是否超越。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Fix issue time, valid period and section threshold before counting exceedances. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 集合超越機率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ensemble exceedance probability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「集合超越機率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ensemble exceedance probability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 集合全部偏低時，即使成員看似一致也可能漏掉洪水。若只用集合範圍當絕對上下界，會掩蓋共同模式誤差，需以獨立事件檢查可靠度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A consistently low ensemble can miss flooding despite strong member agreement. Treating its range as an absolute physical bound conceals shared model error, requiring reliability checks against independent observed events. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：操作比較應同時看後果與機率，並透過過往未參與校準的事件檢查可靠度，而不是只選最樂觀的成員作決策依據。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare consequences as well as probabilities, and evaluate reliability on events excluded from calibration instead of basing decisions on the most optimistic member.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「集合中四成成員超越就保證真實洪水機率恰為四成」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Forty percent ensemble exceedance guarantees the true flood probability is exactly forty percent" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 集合全部偏低時，即使成員看似一致也可能漏掉洪水。若只用集合範圍當絕對上下界，會掩蓋共同模式誤差，需以獨立事件檢查可靠度。
knowledge.textEn: A consistently low ensemble can miss flooding despite strong member agreement. Treating its range as an absolute physical bound conceals shared model error, requiring reliability checks against independent observed events.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「集合超越機率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ensemble exceedance probability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
集合全部偏低時，即使成員看似一致也可能漏掉洪水。
九成分位數就是所有可能洪水永遠不會超越的上限
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A consistently low ensemble can miss flooding despite strong member agreement.
The ninetieth percentile is an upper bound that every possible flood must obey
quiz.explanation: 集合全部偏低時，即使成員看似一致也可能漏掉洪水。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A consistently low ensemble can miss flooding despite strong member agreement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 分位數與有限成員：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Quantiles with finite ensembles: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分位數與有限成員」如何影響洪水預報與水庫聯合操作的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Quantiles with finite ensembles” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Flood forecasting and coordinated reservoir operation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 集合分位數把排序後的情境濃縮為可讀摘要，但小集合的高分位數會對插值規則及個別極端成員敏感。分位數描述預報分布的位置，不是平均值的信賴區間，也不是所有可能洪水的上限。比較不同系統時應保留相同分位數定義、權重與有效時段，並報告成員數。操作評估還需檢視完整歷線，因為單一峰值分位數可能無法代表水量和峰值到達時間之間的關係。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分位數與有限成員」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ensemble quantiles summarize ordered scenarios, but high quantiles in a small set are sensitive to interpolation and individual extremes. A quantile locates a forecast distribution; it is neither a confidence interval for the mean nor a bound on every possible flood. Preserve definitions, weights and valid periods when comparing systems, and report member count. Examine complete hydrographs because a peak quantile alone may miss relationships between flood volume and arrival time that matter for storage decisions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Quantiles with finite ensembles” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：ordered-flows=[80,100,120,140,160] m3/s; q=0.9 dimensionless; h=(5-1)*q=3.6 zero-based-rank; Qq=140+0.6*(160-140)=152 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: ordered-flows=[80,100,120,140,160] m3/s; q=0.9 dimensionless; h=(5-1)*q=3.6 zero-based-rank; Qq=140+0.6*(160-140)=152 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「九成分位數就是所有可能洪水永遠不會超越的上限」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The ninetieth percentile is an upper bound that every possible flood must obey" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分位數與有限成員」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Quantiles with finite ensembles”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分位數與有限成員
knowledge.text: 集合分位數把排序後的情境濃縮為可讀摘要，但小集合的高分位數會對插值規則及個別極端成員敏感。分位數描述預報分布的位置，不是平均值的信賴區間，也不是所有可能洪水的上限。
knowledge.textEn: Ensemble quantiles summarize ordered scenarios, but high quantiles in a small set are sensitive to interpolation and individual extremes. A quantile locates a forecast distribution; it is neither a confidence interval for the mean nor a bound on every possible flood.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：九成分位數就是所有可能洪水永遠不會超越的上限 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The ninetieth percentile is an upper bound that every possible flood must obey Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分位數與有限成員」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Quantiles with finite ensembles" is correct?
options: 九成分位數就是所有可能洪水永遠不會超越的上限
只用發生洪水的日期評分就能公平驗證所有機率預報
集合分位數把排序後的情境濃縮為可讀摘要，但小集合的高分位數會對插值規則及個別極端成員敏感。
optionsEn: The ninetieth percentile is an upper bound that every possible flood must obey
Scoring only flood dates fairly validates every probabilistic forecast system
Ensemble quantiles summarize ordered scenarios, but high quantiles in a small set are sensitive to interpolation and individual extremes.
quiz.explanation: 集合分位數把排序後的情境濃縮為可讀摘要，但小集合的高分位數會對插值規則及個別極端成員敏感。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Ensemble quantiles summarize ordered scenarios, but high quantiles in a small set are sensitive to interpolation and individual extremes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分位數與有限成員：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Quantiles with finite ensembles: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分位數與有限成員」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Quantiles with finite ensembles” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：ordered-flows=[80,100,120,140,160] m3/s; q=0.9 dimensionless; h=(5-1)*q=3.6 zero-based-rank; Qq=140+0.6*(160-140)=152 m3/s。適用邊界：指定線性插值經驗分位數，五個成員不能證明尾部分布校準。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: ordered-flows=[80,100,120,140,160] m3/s; q=0.9 dimensionless; h=(5-1)*q=3.6 zero-based-rank; Qq=140+0.6*(160-140)=152 m3/s. Applicable boundary: Specified linearly interpolated empirical quantile; five members do not establish tail calibration. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：保存原始排序值與使用的插值規則，手算相鄰兩成員及權重，再與軟體結果比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Preserve sorted values and interpolation rules, manually checking neighbouring members and weights against software output.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：ordered-flows=[80,100,120,140,160] m3/s; q=0.9 dimensionless; h=(5-1)*q=3.6 zero-based-rank; Qq=140+0.6*(160-140)=152 m3/s。適用邊界：指定線性插值經驗分位數，五個成員不能證明尾部分布校準。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: ordered-flows=[80,100,120,140,160] m3/s; q=0.9 dimensionless; h=(5-1)*q=3.6 zero-based-rank; Qq=140+0.6*(160-140)=152 m3/s. Applicable boundary: Specified linearly interpolated empirical quantile; five members do not establish tail calibration.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「分位數與有限成員」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Quantiles with finite ensembles", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：ordered-flows=[80,100,120,140,160] m3/s; q=0.9 dimensionless; h=(5-1)*q=3.6 zero-based-rank; Qq=140+0.6*(160-140)=152 m3/s。
同一時刻兩座水庫的出流必然在下游同時到達
目標庫容除以最大閘流量就能保證預洩方案可執行
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: ordered-flows=[80,100,120,140,160] m3/s.
Releases from two reservoirs at the same time necessarily arrive downstream together
Target storage divided by maximum gate discharge guarantees an executable prerelease plan
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：ordered-flows=[80,100,120,140,160] m3/s; q=0.9 dimensionless; h=(5-1)*q=3.6 zero-based-rank; Qq=140+0.6*(160-140)=152 m3/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: ordered-flows=[80,100,120,140,160] m3/s; q=0.9 dimensionless; h=(5-1)*q=3.6 zero-based-rank; Qq=140+0.6*(160-140)=152 m3/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 分位數與有限成員：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Quantiles with finite ensembles: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分位數與有限成員」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Quantiles with finite ensembles” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 保存原始排序值與使用的插值規則，手算相鄰兩成員及權重，再與軟體結果比較。用另一種常見分位數定義做差異檢查，若高分位變動大，應報成員有限造成的不穩定，而不是隱藏選法。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Preserve sorted values and interpolation rules, manually checking neighbouring members and weights against software output. Compare an alternative quantile convention. Large high-quantile differences should be reported as finite-ensemble instability rather than concealed by an undocumented choice of method. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把最高成員改成每秒二百立方公尺重算同一分位數，其他值與定義不變。說明單一成員敏感度如何影響解讀，並保留原始情境供水量分析。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only the largest member to two hundred cubic metres per second and recompute the same quantile. Explain sensitivity to one member and retain complete scenarios for subsequent flood-volume analysis.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把不同時刻的各自高分位拼成一條歷線，可能產生不存在於任何成員的水量與峰型組合。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Joining pointwise high quantiles can create a volume and peak shape found in no individual member. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 保存原始排序值與使用的插值規則，手算相鄰兩成員及權重，再與軟體結果比較。用另一種常見分位數定義做差異檢查，若高分位變動大，應報成員有限造成的不穩定，而不是隱藏選法。
knowledge.textEn: Preserve sorted values and interpolation rules, manually checking neighbouring members and weights against software output. Compare an alternative quantile convention. Large high-quantile differences should be reported as finite-ensemble instability rather than concealed by an undocumented choice of method.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把最高成員改成每秒二百立方公尺重算同一分位數，其他值與定義不變。說明單一成員敏感度如何影響解讀，並保留原始情境供水量分析。
knowledge.textEn: Change only the largest member to two hundred cubic metres per second and recompute the same quantile. Explain sensitivity to one member and retain complete scenarios for subsequent flood-volume analysis.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分位數與有限成員」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Quantiles with finite ensembles"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
保存原始排序值與使用的插值規則，手算相鄰兩成員及權重，再與軟體結果比較。
情境違反比例相同就代表兩個方案具有完全相同後果
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Preserve sorted values and interpolation rules, manually checking neighbouring members and weights against software output.
Equal scenario violation fractions mean that two plans have identical consequences
quiz.explanation: 保存原始排序值與使用的插值規則，手算相鄰兩成員及權重，再與軟體結果比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Preserve sorted values and interpolation rules, manually checking neighbouring members and weights against software output. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 分位數與有限成員：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Quantiles with finite ensembles: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分位數與有限成員」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Quantiles with finite ensembles” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把不同時刻的各自高分位拼成一條歷線，可能產生不存在於任何成員的水量與峰型組合。應標示此為摘要包絡，不能當成一個一致情境。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Joining pointwise high quantiles can create a volume and peak shape found in no individual member. Label such a curve as a summary envelope rather than treating it as one dynamically consistent forecast scenario. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：操作評估還需檢視完整歷線，因為單一峰值分位數可能無法代表水量和峰值到達時間之間的關係。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Examine complete hydrographs because a peak quantile alone may miss relationships between flood volume and arrival time that matter for storage decisions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「九成分位數就是所有可能洪水永遠不會超越的上限」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The ninetieth percentile is an upper bound that every possible flood must obey" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把不同時刻的各自高分位拼成一條歷線，可能產生不存在於任何成員的水量與峰型組合。應標示此為摘要包絡，不能當成一個一致情境。
knowledge.textEn: Joining pointwise high quantiles can create a volume and peak shape found in no individual member. Label such a curve as a summary envelope rather than treating it as one dynamically consistent forecast scenario.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分位數與有限成員」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Quantiles with finite ensembles" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只用發生洪水的日期評分就能公平驗證所有機率預報
若把不同時刻的各自高分位拼成一條歷線，可能產生不存在於任何成員的水量與峰型組合。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Scoring only flood dates fairly validates every probabilistic forecast system
Joining pointwise high quantiles can create a volume and peak shape found in no individual member.
quiz.explanation: 若把不同時刻的各自高分位拼成一條歷線，可能產生不存在於任何成員的水量與峰型組合。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Joining pointwise high quantiles can create a volume and peak shape found in no individual member. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
